The bidder must exhibit advanced skill in OSPF (Open Shortest Path First).

The bidder must be responsible for everything needed to ensure the availability of the training environment.

The bidder must have at least 3 years of experience in enterprise software integration, specifically in XML, PDF generation engines, and database connectors (Oracle).

The bidder must not be in receivership unless special authorization has been issued by the competent judicial authority.
ISO 27001 certification is recommended for the bidder.

The bidder must provide certifications held along with copies.
The bidder must submit relevant project references.

The bidder must provide a training plan, training materials, and execution for all functional areas within the scope.
The bidder must assign experienced instructors to deliver the lectures in the courses.
The bidder must submit a list of suggested external training if applicable.
The bidder must ensure their solution is not based on old or obsolete technologies.
